name: claude-grasp
description: How well do you understand the code Claude Code wrote for you? A score for every file, with the reasons behind it.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No files edited by Claude Code found yet.
Claude Grasp reads your Claude Code sessions (~/.claude*) and scores every file Claude changed.
[Open Demo](command:claudeGrasp.openDemo)
[Open Guide](command:claudeGrasp.openGuide)
[Settings](command:claudeGrasp.openSettings)

colors.description: Claude Grasp: Familiar files (score 70 or more).

claudeGrasp.configDirs.markdownDescription: Claude Code config folders to read, e.g. `~/.claude` and `~/.claude-work`. Leave empty to find every `~/.claude*` folder automatically (plus `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`). Each folder is one Claude account.

claudeGrasp.ignore.markdownDescription: Files that never get a score, as globs (`**/generated/**`, `*.pb.go`). Lockfiles, bundles, source maps and snapshots are always left out, and so are files git ignores or that no longer exist.

claudeGrasp.gitEmails.markdownDescription: Your git author emails, if you commit under more than one. Each repo's `git config user.email` always counts; commits by anyone else (teammates) never count as you changing the file yourself.

claudeGrasp.quiz.enabled.markdownDescription: Turn on the daily explain-back quiz: a short question about code Claude wrote today, graded by your own `claude -p`. A good answer raises that file's score. Off by default.

claudeGrasp.quiz.questionsPerDay.markdownDescription: How many questions the daily quiz asks (1–5).

claudeGrasp.quiz.reminder.markdownDescription: When the quiz is on, offer today's question once a day with a small notification. You can always skip it.

claudeGrasp.quiz.disabledConfigDirs.markdownDescription: Claude config folders whose code must **never** be sent to `claude -p` for the quiz (e.g. a work account). Their files still get scores.

claudeGrasp.claudePath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `claude` program, if Claude Grasp can't find it (shell aliases aren't visible to VS Code). Only used by the quiz.

claudeGrasp.model.markdownDescription: Model for the quiz, passed as `claude -p --model`. Empty: the account's default.

claudeGrasp.penalties.unattended.markdownDescription: Points taken from a file when all of it was written by headless `claude -p` runs that nobody watched (scaled by the share of its lines). `0` turns it off.

claudeGrasp.penalties.bareApproval.markdownDescription: Points taken when the turns that changed a file started with just "ok", "continue", "yes" (scaled by their share). **Off (0) by default**, since many people work this way. Strict setting: `20`.

claudeGrasp.penalties.autoAccept.markdownDescription: Points taken for lines accepted without you looking (auto-accept, allow rules, bypass mode), scaled by their share. **Off (0) by default**. Strict setting: `10`.

claudeGrasp.penalties.codeVolume.markdownDescription: Points taken when Claude wrote a lot of code for very few of your words (none up to 3 lines per word, all at 15). **Off (0) by default**. Strict setting: `15`.

claudeGrasp.penalties.failedQuiz.markdownDescription: Points taken per quiz answer graded below 60%. **Off (0) by default**: a wrong answer simply earns nothing. Skipping never costs points. Strict setting: `10`.

claudeGrasp.explorerBadges.markdownDescription: Show each file's score as a small colored badge in the Explorer and on editor tabs.

claudeGrasp.codeLens.markdownDescription: Above the first line of each file Claude edited, show its score and a **Mark as reviewed** action for when you've read Claude's changes.

claudeGrasp.refreshIntervalMinutes.markdownDescription: How often to read new Claude Code sessions, in minutes. `0`: only at startup and when you press Refresh.
